verdict.rationale: The AI Auth Strategy entity declares an inbound authentication mechanism, such as OIDC via an enterprise IdP, and attaches it to specific AI Models, AI Agents, or MCP Servers. That gives per-resource access scoping for agent clients. Per-consumer spend limits and rate limits add usage bounds. However, the evidence never shows the gateway actually issuing per-agent credentials with explicit scopes or permission sets. missing for 10: explicit credential/key issuance for agents, documented scope or permission granularity per credential, rotation/revocation details, hands-on corroboration.
